label: UNDERSTANDING HIM

cover.headline: Mixed signals? *5 ways to get clarity*

points.heading: Look at patterns, not moments
points.body: One sweet text doesn’t outweigh weeks of silence.
points.panel: Notice what he does over a month, not just one evening.

points.heading: Ask directly, kindly
points.body: Clarity often comes from simply asking.
points.panel: “I like spending time with you. Where do you see this going?”

points.heading: Say what you want too
points.body: It’s easier for him to be clear when you are.

points.heading: Listen to the answer
points.body: If he says he’s not sure, believe him.
points.panel: Take his words at face value, not at hopeful value.

points.heading: Decide what you need
points.body: Confusion is information. You can choose what you accept.
points.panel: “Does this feel good to me most of the time?”

close.save: Save this for the next confusing week.

caption:
Hot one week, distant the next. Mixed signals can keep you guessing for months.

You don’t need to decode every text. Clarity usually comes from looking at patterns, asking honestly, and being clear about what you want. Here are five ways to do that, without games or guessing.
